test_to_pil_image: test the to_pil_image function converts numpy and torch arrays to PIL images with correct resizing
test_resize: test the resize function resizes numpy images while preserving or changing channel dimension format
test_normalize: test the normalize function computes per-channel normalization with correct dtype preservation

test_pad: test the pad function pads images with constant, reflect, replicate, and symmetric modes
